يبتلعان (form VIII)
# يَبْتَلِعَانِ (yabtaliʕāni) /jab.ta.li.ʕaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# يُبْتَلَعَانِ (yubtalaʕāni) /jub.ta.la.ʕaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
